sources.name: EIA weekly petroleum stocks (WPSR)
sources.licence: US federal government work (public domain); EIA API terms

rule.why: week ends Friday; WPSR prints Wednesday 10:30 ET, Thursday in holiday weeks -> Thursday 17:00 UTC is late in both

sources.mechanism: weekly US inventories are the physical balance of the crude market; a draw against the seasonal norm tightens the front of the curve
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: fails when hurricane shut-ins or SPR releases move stocks for policy or weather reasons the market already priced from other feeds

sources.name: EIA weekly natural gas storage (Lower 48)

rule.why: week ends Friday; report Thursday 10:30 ET, Wed/Fri in holiday weeks -> Friday 17:00 UTC

sources.mechanism: storage injections against the five-year norm are the weather-adjusted supply balance of US gas
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: fails when LNG export outages or reclassifications move the number without a change in the weather balance

sources.name: Nasdaq Data Link free tables: LBMA gold/silver PM fix, OPEC basket
sources.licence: Nasdaq Data Link free-data terms; LBMA/OPEC attribution

rule.why: the PM fix is set 15:00 London; the next UTC midnight is after it

sources.mechanism: the auction fixes and the OPEC reference basket are the physical-settlement prices contracts are written on; their gap to the screen is a settlement-flow signal
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: fails when the fix is dominated by the screen it is compared with (liquid days), which is when settlement flows are smallest
sources.note: dataset codes are the legacy Quandl free codes; if Nasdaq has moved them to QDL datatables set series.<name>.table=true and code=QDL/LBMA

sources.licence: e-Stat API terms (free application ID; attribution to the Statistics Bureau / Cabinet Office)

rule.why: household spending prints ~5-6 weeks after the month, machinery orders ~6-7 weeks; 45 days is the floor, the leg lifts it to first sight

sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: fails in months when a consumption-tax or subsidy calendar moves spending mechanically, a Japan-specific schedule

sources.name: KOSIS: Korea CPI and exports

rule.why: CPI prints on the first business days of the next month; trade on the 1st

sources.mechanism: Korean exports are the first monthly read of the global goods cycle and of semiconductor demand; CPI sets the BoK path for the won
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: fails when Chuseok and Lunar New Year working-day shifts distort the month, a calendar that does not coincide with US surprise regimes
sources.note: orgId/tblId defaults are UNCONFIRMED; a wrong id returns KOSIS's own err object, recorded

sources.name: Reddit OAuth app-only: instrument mentions in trading subreddits
sources.licence: Reddit Data API terms: commercial use requires a separate agreement

rule.why: a day's count is complete at the next UTC midnight; only completed days are recorded

sources.mechanism: retail attention spikes precede retail order flow into the named instrument, which mean-reverts once the crowd is positioned
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: fails when attention is news-driven and institutional flow arrives with it, which a mention count cannot tell apart
sources.note: the anonymous JSON reader (#129 free_stack reddit, side_channels/reddit_miner) keeps running; this is the keyed reach beyond its rate limit

sources.name: BIS central bank policy rates (WS_CBPOL, monthly)
sources.licence: BIS statistics terms (free reuse with attribution)

rule.why: a month's policy rate is its last decision, published within days; +7 days is after BIS's update

sources.mechanism: the policy-rate path sets carry and the rate differential every FX cross is priced on; BIS publishes one comparable panel
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: fails when intervention, yield-curve control or capital controls (JP, CH, KR) decouple the currency from its policy rate

sources.name: OECD composite leading indicators and business confidence (SDMX)

rule.why: the CLI for month M is released around the 10th of M+1 with a one-month lag; 40 days is late, the leg lifts it to first sight

sources.mechanism: the CLI turns ahead of the business cycle by six to nine months; index and pro-cyclical FX repricing follows the turn
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: fails when heavy revisions rewrite the turning point (the first vintage is kept, so the cell sees what was known) and in policy-driven cycles (CN)
sources.note: dimension keys are UNCONFIRMED; OECD returns its own error text for a wrong key, recorded

sources.name: IMF COFER reserve currency shares and IRFCL official reserves (SDMX)
sources.licence: IMF data terms (free reuse with attribution)

rule.why: COFER for quarter Q is released at the end of the following quarter; IRFCL monthly ~60 days (per-series lag)

sources.mechanism: official reserve managers are slow, large, price-insensitive holders; a drawdown of reserves is intervention (defending the currency), a shift in currency shares is diversification flow
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: fails when valuation effects (the dollar's own move) change reported shares without any reallocation, and when intervention is hidden in forwards
sources.note: dataflow and dimension keys are UNCONFIRMED against the 2025 IMF SDMX API; a wrong key returns the IMF's own error, recorded
